submission.bindingBasis: The planning digest (e5d8008d...) mismatches the current source state digest (79bcb09f...). The owner contract requires compare-and-close against an exact expected digest, and a mismatched planning digest fails not_committed. The consequenceBoundaryEvidence shows currentSourceStateDigest differs from planningEvidence sourceStateDigest, so the planning binding is stale. A re-observation is required to obtain the new exact current digest before close can be attempted.
submission.rationale: The planning evidence's sourceStateDigest (sha256:e5d8...) does not match the currentSourceStateDigest (sha256:79bc...) observed at the consequence boundary. Although the tree bytes are identical, the contract explicitly operates on the exact sourceStateDigest (compare-and-close against one exact expected digest), and the planningBindingAttempt already resulted in REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed against the planning digest. Per the owner contract, "after re-observation a caller may close against the new exact current digest." The correct action is to re-observe to obtain the new exact current digest, then close against it. Attempting ACT_WITH_PLANNING_BINDING would fail not_committed; there is no evidence of a different commit delta to replay in a semantically meaningful way since the tree bytes are identical, so the safe, contract-conformant path is re-observation.
